heroHeadline: CDC count jumps to 4,410 measles cases as Pennsylvania requests federal help
heroSubtitle: CDC counts 4,410 confirmed 2026 cases (+330 in a week), about 93% above all of 2025, with 451 hospitalizations and 42 outbreaks across 47 jurisdictions. Pennsylvania has at least 1,200 cases and six deaths, and has requested CDC Epi-Aid support. PAHO's US elimination status decision remains due November 2026.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
